requirements.title: Goroutine termination signal check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (ANA001) for every goroutine body that contains no channel receive, select, or context.Done() reference, indicating the goroutine has no mechanism to receive a termination signal.

requirements.title: Goroutine-in-loop detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (ANA002) when a go statement appears inside a for or range loop body, indicating unbounded goroutine creation.

requirements.title: Blocking sleep in goroutine detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (ANA003) when a time.Sleep call is found inside a goroutine body, indicating a blocking pattern that prevents cooperative cancellation.

requirements.title: Defer-in-loop detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (ANA004) when a defer statement appears inside a for or range loop body, indicating deferred cleanup that will not execute until the enclosing function returns.

requirements.title: Missing config file returns ErrNoConfig
requirements.text: config.Load shall return an error wrapping fusa.ErrNoConfig when the specified .fusa.json file does not exist, allowing callers to distinguish absence from malformation.

requirements.title: Malformed config JSON returns error
requirements.text: config.Load shall return a non-nil error when .fusa.json contains syntactically invalid JSON, preventing silent use of a corrupted configuration.

requirements.title: Missing version field returns ErrInvalidConfig
requirements.text: config.Validate shall return an error wrapping fusa.ErrInvalidConfig when the version field is empty or absent.

requirements.title: Unsupported report format returns ErrInvalidConfig
requirements.text: config.Validate shall return an error wrapping fusa.ErrInvalidConfig when report.format is set to a value other than the empty string, 'text', or 'json'.

requirements.title: Default config is valid and uses safe defaults
requirements.text: config.Default shall return a Config with version='1', standard='generic', and report.format='text', which must pass Validate without error.

requirements.title: Config round-trips through JSON save and load
requirements.text: A Config written by config.Save and read back by config.Load shall be identical to the original, preserving all fields including Rules.Exclude, Project.ASIL, and Project.SIL.

requirements.title: Excluded rule IDs are skipped during engine run
requirements.text: Rule IDs listed in Config.Rules.Exclude shall not execute during engine.Registry.Run; their findings shall be absent from the result.

requirements.title: Per-rule severity override in configuration
requirements.text: Config.Rules.Severity shall be a map from rule ID to severity string ('ERROR', 'WARNING', or 'INFO'); after a rule executes, any finding whose rule ID appears in this map shall have its severity replaced with the configured value.

requirements.title: No-subcommand invocation prints usage and exits non-zero
requirements.text: When gofusa is invoked with no arguments, the CLI shall print a usage message and exit with a non-zero status code.

requirements.title: Unknown subcommand exits non-zero
requirements.text: When gofusa is invoked with an unrecognised subcommand, the CLI shall print an error message and exit with a non-zero status code.

requirements.title: Help command prints usage and exits zero
requirements.text: gofusa help (and --help, -h) shall print usage information that includes the tool name and available subcommands, and exit with status 0.

requirements.title: Version command prints version string and exits zero
requirements.text: gofusa version shall print a string containing the tool name and semver version, and exit with status 0.

requirements.title: Check exits zero when no ERROR findings are present
requirements.text: gofusa check shall exit with status 0 when the engine produces no findings of ERROR severity.

requirements.title: Check exits one when any ERROR finding is present
requirements.text: gofusa check shall exit with status 1 when the engine produces at least one finding of ERROR severity, signalling a blocking safety violation to CI pipelines.

requirements.title: Qualify exits zero and writes report when all cases pass
requirements.text: gofusa qualify shall exit with status 0 and write qualify-report.json when every built-in qualification case passes.

requirements.title: gofusa lint runs only lint rules
requirements.text: gofusa lint shall run only rules whose ID begins with 'LINT', producing the same output format as gofusa check and accepting the same --dir, --format, --output, and --strict flags.

requirements.title: gofusa analyze runs only analyze rules
requirements.text: gofusa analyze shall run only rules whose ID begins with 'ANA', producing the same output format as gofusa check and accepting the same --dir, --format, --output, and --strict flags.

requirements.title: gofusa template generates safety document templates
requirements.text: gofusa template shall generate one or more safety document templates (SAFETY_PLAN.md, TEST_EVIDENCE.md, HARA.md) in the specified output directory, accepting --dir and --type flags.

requirements.title: --strict flag exits non-zero on WARNING or ERROR findings
requirements.text: When gofusa check (or any filtered subcommand) is invoked with --strict, it shall exit with status 1 when any finding of WARNING or ERROR severity is present, even if no ERROR-only findings exist.

requirements.title: gofusa safety-case generates safety case files
requirements.text: gofusa safety-case shall write safety-case.json (machine-readable), safety-case.md (Markdown), and safety-case.mermaid (GSN diagram) to the output directory, accepting --dir, --output-dir, and --standard flags.

requirements.title: Safety case presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (SAFETYCASE001) when no safety-case.json safety case document is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Safety case Build collects evidence items from project root
requirements.text: safetycase.Build shall read evidence files (check-report.json, .fusa-reqs.json, .fusa-evidence.json, qualify-report.json, sbom.json, provenance.json) from projectRoot and return a SafetyCase with an EvidenceItem for each file indicating its presence status and detail.

requirements.title: SafetyCase gaps slice lists absent evidence IDs
requirements.text: The Gaps field of a SafetyCase shall contain the ID of every EvidenceItem whose Status is absent; the slice shall be empty when all evidence is present.

requirements.title: Render supports text, JSON, and Mermaid formats
requirements.text: safetycase.Render shall write the safety case as Markdown when format is 'text', as JSON when format is 'json' or empty, and as a Mermaid flowchart when format is 'mermaid'; it shall return an error for any other value.

requirements.title: Mermaid output uses G/S/Sn node prefixes and hierarchical connections
requirements.text: The Mermaid output shall use G-prefixed nodes for goals, S-prefixed nodes for strategies, and Sn-prefixed nodes for solutions; the top goal G1 shall connect to the strategy S1 which connects to all sub-goals.

requirements.title: Compliance mapping for iso26262, iec61508, iso21434, and generic standards
requirements.text: safetycase.Build shall include compliance clause mappings for the configured standard; supported values are 'iso26262', 'iec61508', 'iso21434', and 'generic'; unrecognised values shall default to generic mappings.

requirements.title: Rules execute in deterministic ID-sorted order
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Rules shall return rules sorted lexicographically by ID, ensuring that rule execution order and report output are deterministic across runs.

requirements.title: Rule execution errors are collected without aborting the run
requirements.text: When a rule's Run method returns a non-nil error, the engine shall record the error in Result.Errors and continue executing remaining rules rather than aborting the check.

requirements.title: HasErrors reports true when any finding has ERROR severity
requirements.text: engine.Result.HasErrors shall return true if and only if at least one Finding in the result carries SeverityError.

requirements.title: MustRegister panics on duplicate rule ID
requirements.text: engine.Registry.MustRegister shall panic when called with a rule whose ID is already registered, making duplicate registration a hard failure detectable at program startup.

requirements.title: Register returns error for nil rule
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Register shall return a non-nil error when called with a nil rule argument.

requirements.title: Context cancellation halts rule execution
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Run shall stop executing rules and return promptly when the supplied context is cancelled, enabling timeout and cancellation support in CI pipelines.

requirements.title: RunFilter runs only rules matching a keep predicate
requirements.text: engine.Registry.RunFilter shall accept a keep func(Rule) bool predicate and execute only rules for which keep returns true, enabling focused rule subsets such as lint-only or analyze-only runs.

requirements.title: ErrNoConfig is the sentinel for absent configuration
requirements.text: fusa.ErrNoConfig shall be a non-nil sentinel error that callers can test with errors.Is to distinguish a missing .fusa.json from other I/O or parse errors.

requirements.title: ErrInvalidConfig is the sentinel for malformed configuration
requirements.text: fusa.ErrInvalidConfig shall be a non-nil sentinel error that callers can test with errors.Is to identify configuration validation failures.

requirements.title: ErrCheckFailed is the sentinel for ERROR-severity check failures
requirements.text: fusa.ErrCheckFailed shall be a non-nil sentinel error representing a check run in which one or more ERROR-severity findings were produced, suitable for wrapping in higher-level error values.

requirements.title: Configuration file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR finding (FUSA001) when no .fusa.json configuration file is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Go module file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an ERROR finding (FUSA002) when no go.mod file is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: License file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (FUSA003) when no LICENSE file is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: README file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (FUSA004) when no README file is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: CI configuration presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (FUSA005) when no CI workflow file is found under .github/workflows/.

requirements.title: Discarded error return detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (LINT001) for every multi-value assignment where a blank identifier discards an error return value.

requirements.title: Panic call detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (LINT002) for every panic() call found in non-test Go source files.

requirements.title: Recover call inventory
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (LINT003) for every recover() call found in Go source files, providing an inventory of panic recovery points.

requirements.title: Unsafe package import detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (LINT004) for every import of the 'unsafe' package.

requirements.title: Reflect package import inventory
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (LINT005) for every import of the 'reflect' package, providing an inventory of reflection usage.

requirements.title: Global mutable variable detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (LINT006) for every package-level var declaration, providing an inventory of global mutable state.

requirements.title: No external runtime dependencies
requirements.text: The go-FuSa module shall declare no external runtime dependencies in go.mod. All functionality shall be implemented using the Go standard library only, ensuring supply-chain integrity.

requirements.title: All timestamps use UTC
requirements.text: All GeneratedAt timestamps in reports, evidence bundles, SBOMs, provenance records, and qualification reports shall use UTC, ensuring consistent interpretation across time zones.

requirements.title: Recognised safety standard identifiers
requirements.text: The config.Standard type shall accept the identifiers ISO26262, IEC61508, ISO21434, DO178C, and generic, covering the principal functional safety and cybersecurity standards.

requirements.title: Tool qualification report presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (QUALIFY001) when no qualify-report.json tool qualification report is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Qualification report structure
requirements.text: A qualification report produced by qualify.Run shall include Go version, UTC generation timestamp, total/passed/failed case counts, and the full per-case result list.

requirements.title: Qualification cases run in isolated temporary directories
requirements.text: Each qualification test case shall execute in its own isolated OS temporary directory that is created before the case runs and deleted after it completes, preventing cross-case contamination.

requirements.title: Qualification report integrity hash
requirements.text: The qualification report shall include a Hash field containing the SHA-256 digest (lowercase hex, 64 characters) of the report JSON excluding the Hash field itself, enabling tampering detection.

requirements.title: qualify.Load reads qualification report from disk
requirements.text: qualify.Load shall read a qualification report from the given path, returning fusa.ErrNoConfig when the file does not exist and fusa.ErrInvalidConfig when the JSON is malformed.

requirements.title: qualify.BuiltinCases returns non-empty test suite
requirements.text: qualify.BuiltinCases shall return a non-empty slice of qualification test cases, with one positive (expects finding) and one negative (expects no finding) case for each registered engine rule.

requirements.title: SBOM presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (RELEASE001) when no sbom.json Software Bill of Materials is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Build provenance presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (RELEASE002) when no provenance.json build provenance record is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: SBOM includes module path, Go version, and direct dependencies
requirements.text: release.BuildSBOM shall produce an SBOM that includes the module path from go.mod, the Go toolchain version from go.mod, and all direct dependencies listed in the require block.

requirements.title: SBOM components include dependency name, version, and hash
requirements.text: Each Component in the SBOM shall include the dependency module path, the declared version, and the h1: hash from go.sum where available.

requirements.title: Provenance record includes build environment fields
requirements.text: release.BuildProvenance shall produce a record that includes module path, Go runtime version, GOOS, and GOARCH, providing a complete build environment fingerprint.

requirements.title: SBOM and provenance serialise as valid JSON
requirements.text: release.SaveJSON shall write any SBOM or Provenance value as indented, valid JSON that can be parsed by a standard JSON decoder.

requirements.title: SBOM output conforms to SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD format
requirements.text: release.ToSPDX31 shall convert an SBOM to an SPDX 3.0.1 JSON-LD document containing a @context pointing to the SPDX 3.0.1 context URL and a @graph with CreationInfo, Tool, SpdxDocument, and software_Package elements.

requirements.title: Artifact manifest records SHA-256 hashes for all release files
requirements.text: release.BuildManifest shall accept a list of file paths and produce a Manifest containing the path and SHA-256 hex digest for each file, failing if any file cannot be read.

requirements.title: Provenance builder field auto-detected from CI environment
requirements.text: release.DetectBuilder shall return a non-empty builder string when running in GitHub Actions (GITHUB_ACTIONS=true with GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF set, producing 'github-actions:<ref>') or when FUSA_BUILDER is set. A non-empty override argument takes the highest priority. An empty string is returned when none of the signals are present, causing the builder field to be omitted from provenance.json in local builds.

requirements.title: Text report includes rule ID, severity, and location
requirements.text: The text-format report shall include for each finding: the rule ID, severity label, and location in file:line:column format when line and column are present.

requirements.title: Text report shows PASS or FAIL result line
requirements.text: The text-format report shall end with 'Result: PASS' when there are no ERROR-severity findings, and 'Result: FAIL' when at least one ERROR-severity finding exists.

requirements.title: Report summary counts match finding severities
requirements.text: report.New shall compute Summary.Total, Errors, Warnings, and Infos by counting findings in the provided slice; the counts shall equal the actual numbers of findings at each severity.

requirements.title: JSON report is valid parseable JSON
requirements.text: The json-format report shall produce output that can be decoded by a standard JSON decoder into a report.Report struct without error.

requirements.title: JSON report includes all required top-level fields
requirements.text: The json-format report shall include the fields generatedAt, projectRoot, findings, and summary at the top level.

requirements.title: Requirements manifest presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (TRACE001) when no .fusa-reqs.json requirements manifest is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Requirement implementation traceability check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (TRACE002) for every requirement in .fusa-reqs.json that has no matching //fusa:req implementation tag in any Go source file.

requirements.title: TracedRequirements count is accurate
requirements.text: The Coverage.TracedRequirements field of a traceability matrix shall equal the number of requirements in the manifest that have at least one //fusa:req KindImpl tag in the source tree.

requirements.title: TestedRequirements count is accurate
requirements.text: The Coverage.TestedRequirements field of a traceability matrix shall equal the number of requirements in the manifest that have at least one //fusa:test KindTest tag in the source tree.

requirements.title: Scanner excludes vendor, testdata, and hidden directories
requirements.text: trace.ScanTags shall not scan Go files inside vendor/, testdata/, or any directory whose name begins with a dot, preventing false annotations from dependencies or generated files.

requirements.title: Traceability matrix renders in text and JSON formats
requirements.text: trace.Render shall produce a human-readable text format when format is 'text' and a machine-parseable JSON format when format is 'json', returning an error for unknown formats.

requirements.title: Annotations with empty requirement ID are silently skipped
requirements.text: A //fusa:req or //fusa:test annotation with no requirement ID after the prefix shall be silently ignored by trace.ScanTags and shall not produce a tag.

requirements.title: Test evidence bundle presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (VERIFY001) when no .fusa-evidence.json test evidence bundle is present in the project root directory.

requirements.title: Test failure detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (VERIFY002) when the .fusa-evidence.json bundle records one or more failed tests.

requirements.title: Evidence bundle includes provenance fields
requirements.text: An evidence bundle produced by verify.New shall include the project root path, Go runtime version, and a UTC generation timestamp.

requirements.title: Evidence bundle records per-test detail
requirements.text: Each entry in the evidence bundle Results slice shall include the test function name, package path, pass/fail/skip status, and elapsed time in seconds.

requirements.title: verify.Run invokes go test with JSON output
requirements.text: verify.Run shall execute go test -json -count=1 ./... in the specified directory, producing machine-readable output that is parsed into structured test results.

requirements.title: verify.Save persists evidence bundle as indented JSON
requirements.text: verify.Save shall marshal the evidence bundle as indented JSON and write it to the specified path with a trailing newline, returning a non-nil error on marshal or write failure.

requirements.title: verify.Load reads evidence bundle from disk
requirements.text: verify.Load shall read an evidence bundle from the specified path, returning fusa.ErrNoConfig when the file does not exist and a descriptive error when the JSON is malformed.

requirements.title: Full pipeline executes successfully on a minimal Go project
requirements.text: The complete gofusa pipeline (init, check, trace, verify, release, qualify) shall execute in sequence on a minimal Go project and produce all required output artifacts: .fusa.json, .fusa-evidence.json, sbom.json, provenance.json, and qualify-report.json.

requirements.title: dFMEA scanner discovers exported functions from Go source
requirements.text: fmea.Scan shall walk all non-vendor, non-testdata Go source files in the project root and produce one Entry per exported function declaration, including component name, function name, and severity.

requirements.title: Failure modes derived from return types and goroutine usage
requirements.text: fmea.Scan shall derive failure modes and effects heuristically: functions returning error receive 'Returns unexpected error', functions launching goroutines receive 'Goroutine not terminated', and severity is elevated to 'high' when a //fusa:req annotation is present.

requirements.title: RequirementIDs extracted from //fusa:req annotations
requirements.text: fmea.Scan shall parse the doc comment of each exported function and extract all requirement IDs from //fusa:req lines, associating them with the corresponding Entry.

requirements.title: dFMEA report exported in JSON and CSV formats
requirements.text: fmea.Render shall write the Report in 'json' format (indented JSON) or 'csv' format (RFC 4180 with header row: Component, Function, FailureModes, Effects, Severity, DetectionControl, RequirementIDs).

requirements.title: FMEA001 engine rule fires when fmea.json is absent
requirements.text: The FMEA001 engine rule shall emit an INFO finding when fmea.json does not exist in the project root, prompting the user to run 'gofusa fmea'.

requirements.title: Scanner builds package dependency graph from imports
requirements.text: boundary.Scan shall walk all non-vendor, non-testdata Go source files and construct a directed graph of package import relationships within the module, producing one Node per package and one Edge per import relationship.

requirements.title: Exported types and functions identified per package node
requirements.text: boundary.Scan shall collect all exported function names (suffix '()') and exported type names from each package and attach them to the corresponding Node as the Exports slice.

requirements.title: Boundary diagram rendered in Mermaid flowchart format
requirements.text: boundary.Render with format 'mermaid' shall produce a Mermaid flowchart LR diagram with one node per package and directed edges representing import dependencies.

requirements.title: Boundary diagram rendered in DOT (Graphviz) format
requirements.text: boundary.Render with format 'dot' shall produce a valid Graphviz DOT digraph with rankdir=LR, one node per package, and directed edges representing import dependencies.

requirements.title: BOUNDARY001 engine rule fires when boundary.mermaid is absent
requirements.text: The BOUNDARY001 engine rule shall emit an INFO finding when boundary.mermaid does not exist in the project root, prompting the user to run 'gofusa boundary'.

requirements.title: gofusa fmea generates dFMEA JSON and CSV artifacts
requirements.text: The 'gofusa fmea' command shall scan the project root, generate fmea.json and fmea.csv in the output directory, and print a summary of entry counts by severity.

requirements.title: gofusa boundary generates Mermaid and DOT boundary diagrams
requirements.text: The 'gofusa boundary' command shall scan the project root, generate boundary.mermaid and boundary.dot in the output directory, and print a summary of package and edge counts.

requirements.title: Parse go.mod dependencies
requirements.text: The tool shall parse all require entries from go.mod, including block and single-line forms, stripping indirect comments.

requirements.title: Query OSV batch API
requirements.text: The tool shall POST a querybatch request to the OSV API for all parsed dependencies and return one Finding per vulnerable (module, version) pair.

requirements.title: VULN001 engine rule
requirements.text: The engine shall emit an INFO finding VULN001 when vuln.json is absent from the project root.

requirements.title: HTTP error handling
requirements.text: The tool shall return an error when the OSV API responds with a non-200 HTTP status.

requirements.title: Vulnerability report rendering
requirements.text: The tool shall render the vulnerability report in json or text format, returning an error for unsupported formats.

requirements.title: Collect evidence files
requirements.text: Pack shall collect all present standard evidence files from the project root into a ZIP archive.

requirements.title: SHA-256 manifest
requirements.text: Pack shall compute a SHA-256 digest for each collected file and record it in AUDIT-MANIFEST.json inside the archive.

requirements.title: AUDITPACK001 engine rule
requirements.text: The engine shall emit an INFO finding AUDITPACK001 when audit-pack.zip is absent from the project root.

requirements.title: Audit pack format
requirements.text: The audit pack shall be a valid ZIP file containing the evidence files and AUDIT-MANIFEST.json.

requirements.title: HTML report rendering
requirements.text: The report package shall render a self-contained HTML page with findings table, evidence status cards, and summary badge.

requirements.title: Evidence status cards
requirements.text: The HTML report shall include a card for each standard evidence file indicating present or absent status.

requirements.title: Self-contained HTML
requirements.text: The HTML output shall be a single file with no external CDN or network dependencies.

requirements.title: Untraced requirement detection
requirements.text: The engine shall emit a WARNING finding TRACE002 for every requirement with no //fusa:req implementation tag.

requirements.title: Test gap detection
requirements.text: The engine shall emit an INFO finding TRACE003 for every requirement with no //fusa:test tag; gofusa trace --gaps shall list these gaps.

requirements.title: Requirement text completeness
requirements.text: The engine shall emit a WARNING finding TRACE004 for every requirement whose text field is empty or absent.

requirements.title: gofusa vuln command
requirements.text: The CLI shall provide a vuln command that scans go.mod dependencies and writes vuln.json.

requirements.title: gofusa audit-pack command
requirements.text: The CLI shall provide an audit-pack command that bundles all evidence artifacts into audit-pack.zip.

requirements.title: gofusa trace --gaps flag
requirements.text: The trace command shall support a --gaps flag that lists requirements with no //fusa:test tag and exits 1 when gaps exist.

requirements.title: Weak cryptographic hash detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER001) when crypto/md5 or crypto/sha1 is imported, as these are cryptographically broken hash algorithms.

requirements.title: Weak symmetric cipher detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER002) when crypto/des or crypto/rc4 is imported, as DES, 3DES, and RC4 are broken ciphers.

requirements.title: Insecure random source detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (CYBER003) when math/rand is imported, as pseudo-random sources must not be used for security-sensitive values.

requirements.title: Unsafe pointer usage detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER004) when the unsafe package is imported, as it bypasses Go type safety and memory safety guarantees.

requirements.title: Command injection risk detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER005) when exec.Command or exec.CommandContext is called with a non-literal command name, indicating potential OS command injection.

requirements.title: Hardcoded credential detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an ERROR (CYBER006) when a variable or constant with a credential-suggestive name (password, secret, apikey, token, etc.) is assigned a non-empty string literal.

requirements.title: TLS verification disabled detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an ERROR (CYBER007) when InsecureSkipVerify: true appears in a TLS configuration composite literal.

requirements.title: HTTP server without timeout detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER008) when http.ListenAndServe or http.ListenAndServeTLS is called directly, as these use a default server with no timeouts.

requirements.title: Integer narrowing conversion detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (CYBER009) when an explicit narrowing integer conversion (int8/int16/int32/uint8/uint16/uint32/byte) is applied to a non-literal expression.

requirements.title: String concatenation in OS/DB API detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER010) when a string-concatenated expression is passed as the path argument to os.Open/Create/ReadFile/WriteFile or as the query argument to database Query/Exec/Prepare methods.

requirements.title: SSRF detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER011) when http.Get/Post/Head/NewRequest receives a variable (non-literal) URL argument (CWE-918).

requirements.title: pprof profiling endpoint detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER012) when net/http/pprof is imported in production code (gosec G108, CWE-200).

requirements.title: Zip slip path traversal detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an ERROR (CYBER013) when archive/zip is imported and an archive entry's .Name field is passed directly to os.Create/OpenFile/filepath.Join (CWE-23).

requirements.title: TLS minimum version detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER014) when tls.Config.MinVersion is set to tls.VersionTLS10, tls.VersionTLS11, or their numeric equivalents 769/770 (CWE-326).

requirements.title: SQL injection via fmt.Sprintf detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an ERROR (CYBER015) when a database Query/Exec/Prepare method receives a fmt.Sprintf or fmt.Fprintf call as its query argument (CWE-89).

requirements.title: Permissive directory mode detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER016) when os.Mkdir or os.MkdirAll is called with a mode argument greater than 0750 (CWE-732).

requirements.title: Permissive file mode detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER017) when os.OpenFile or os.WriteFile is called with a mode argument greater than 0640 (CWE-732).

requirements.title: Path traversal from HTTP request detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an ERROR (CYBER018) when http.ServeFile or os.Open/Create receives an argument derived from r.URL.Path or r.FormValue (CWE-22).

requirements.title: TOCTOU race condition detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER019) when a function contains both os.Stat and a subsequent os.Open/Create/Remove/Rename call, creating a time-of-check-to-time-of-use race (CWE-362).

requirements.title: Predictable temp file creation detection
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (CYBER020) when os.Create is called with a path derived from os.TempDir() or a /tmp literal, which creates a predictable temp filename (CWE-377).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 configuration file presence
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (IEC62443-001) when no .fusa-iec62443.json configuration file is found in the project root.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 Security Level validity
requirements.text: The tool shall emit a WARNING (IEC62443-002) when .fusa-iec62443.json exists but target_sl is not in the range 1–4.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 Security Policy documentation
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (IEC62443-003) when no SECURITY.md or equivalent security policy document is found in the project.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 Incident Response Plan
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (IEC62443-004) when no incident response plan document is found in the project.

requirements.title: SLSA L2 VCS revision in provenance
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (SLSA001) when provenance.json is missing the vcsRevision field required for SLSA Level 2.

requirements.title: SLSA L2 builder field in provenance
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (SLSA002) when provenance.json is missing the builder field required for SLSA Level 2.

requirements.title: SLSA L3 two-party review evidence
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (SLSA003) when no CODEOWNERS file or branch protection configuration is found, indicating absence of SLSA Level 3 two-party review evidence.

requirements.title: govulncheck call-graph integration
requirements.text: The tool shall use govulncheck call-graph analysis when the govulncheck binary is available, falling back to OSV API scan when it is not.

requirements.title: TARA threat entry structure
requirements.text: Each TARA entry shall include asset, threat description, STRIDE categories, CWE identifier, attack vector, likelihood, impact, IEC 62443 Security Level, current control, and residual risk.

requirements.title: TARA report structure
requirements.text: The TARA report shall include format identifier, generation timestamp, module name, and a list of threat entries.

requirements.title: TARA generation from CYBER findings
requirements.text: The tool shall generate a TARA by mapping CYBER findings to STRIDE/CWE/risk metadata; unknown rule IDs shall produce a default entry rather than being silently dropped.

requirements.title: TARA rendering in JSON and Markdown
requirements.text: The tool shall render a TARA report as JSON (machine-readable) or Markdown table (human-readable safety case evidence).

requirements.title: TARA file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall emit an INFO (TARA001) when no tara.json is found in the project, prompting the user to run 'gofusa tara'.

requirements.title: FMEA cyber risk enrichment
requirements.text: When --cyber is specified, the tool shall cross-reference CYBER findings into FMEA entries by file path and escalate severity to High for ERROR-level findings.

requirements.title: Security test annotation support
requirements.text: The traceability engine shall recognise //fusa:sec-test annotations and count them separately as SecTestedRequirements in the coverage report.

requirements.title: gofusa cyber subcommand
requirements.text: The CLI shall provide a 'cyber' subcommand that runs all CYBER rules, prints a findings summary, and writes cyber-report.json.

requirements.title: gofusa tara subcommand
requirements.text: The CLI shall provide a 'tara' subcommand that runs CYBER rules and generates tara.json and tara.md from the findings.

requirements.title: gofusa fmea --cyber flag
requirements.text: The 'fmea' subcommand shall accept a --cyber flag that enriches FMEA entries with CYBER findings cross-referenced by file path.

requirements.title: Watchdog timer monitors component liveness
requirements.text: runtime.Watchdog shall call onExpiry each check interval when more than timeout has elapsed since the last Kick; it shall not call onExpiry if Kick is called before the timeout elapses.

requirements.title: Heartbeat monitor detects missed beats
requirements.text: runtime.Heartbeat shall call onMissed with the running consecutive-miss count each interval when Beat is not called within that period; it shall reset the miss count when Beat is called.

requirements.title: Safe-state machine enforces terminal emergency stop
requirements.text: runtime.StateManager shall return an error for any Transition call when the current state is StateEmergencyStop; all other valid state transitions shall succeed and invoke the onChange callback.

requirements.title: Diagnostic ring buffer records bounded event history
requirements.text: runtime.DiagManager shall maintain a FIFO ring buffer of up to maxEntries Diagnostic events; when the buffer is full, the oldest entry shall be evicted to make room for the new entry.

requirements.title: Fault threshold monitor fires callback at count threshold
requirements.text: runtime.FaultMonitor shall call onFault(id, count) when the counter for faultID reaches or exceeds the configured threshold; it shall not fire when no threshold is configured for that fault.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 TARA gap engine rule
requirements.text: The engine shall emit an INFO finding (ISO21434001) when tara.json is absent for ISO 21434 projects.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 gap assessment
requirements.text: iso21434.Assess shall scan the project root and return a gap report for the given Cybersecurity Assurance Level, mapping evidence files to ISO 21434 objectives.

requirements.title: ISO 21434 gap report rendering
requirements.text: iso21434.Render shall write the gap report in text or JSON format, returning an error for unsupported formats.

requirements.title: UN R.155 TARA gap engine rule
requirements.text: The engine shall emit a WARNING finding (UNECE001) when tara.json is absent for ISO 21434 / UN R.155 projects.

requirements.title: UN R.155 gap assessment
requirements.text: unece.Assess shall scan the project root and return a UN R.155 Annex 5 gap report mapping evidence files to threat categories.

requirements.title: UN R.155 gap report rendering
requirements.text: unece.Render shall write the gap report in text or JSON format, returning an error for unsupported formats.

requirements.title: SLSA Level type
requirements.text: slsa.Level shall define the four SLSA v1.0 assurance levels L1, L2, L3, L4.

requirements.title: SLSA gap Report type
requirements.text: slsa.Report shall aggregate per-objective SLSA assessment results with project, level, generated timestamp, and pass/gap/na counts.

requirements.title: SLSA gap assessment
requirements.text: slsa.Assess shall scan the project root and return a SLSA v1.0 gap report for the given Level, mapping evidence files to SLSA objectives.

requirements.title: SLSA gap report rendering
requirements.text: slsa.Render shall write the gap report in text or §9.3 JSON format, returning an error for unsupported formats.

requirements.title: gofusa slsa command
requirements.text: gofusa slsa shall run slsa.Assess against --dir, render the result via --format (text|json), and exit with ExitOK (no gaps), ExitGateFail (gaps), ExitUsage (bad flag), or ExitRuntime (I/O error).

requirements.title: IEC 62443 SL type
requirements.text: iec62443.SL shall define the four IEC 62443 Security Levels SL-1, SL-2, SL-3, SL-4.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 gap Report type
requirements.text: iec62443.Report shall aggregate per-objective IEC 62443-4-2 assessment results with project, SL, generated timestamp, and pass/gap/na counts.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 gap assessment
requirements.text: iec62443.Assess shall scan the project root and return an IEC 62443-4-2 gap report for the given SL, mapping evidence files to Component Requirements.

requirements.title: IEC 62443 gap report rendering
requirements.text: iec62443.Render shall write the gap report in text or §9.3 JSON format, returning an error for unsupported formats.

requirements.title: gofusa iec62443 command
requirements.text: gofusa iec62443 shall run iec62443.Assess against --dir, render the result via --format (text|json), and exit with ExitOK (no gaps), ExitGateFail (gaps), ExitUsage (bad flag), or ExitRuntime (I/O error).

requirements.title: Test harness utilities create deterministic project fixtures
requirements.text: testutil.ProjectDir shall create a temporary directory populated with all specified files; testutil.MinimalProject shall return a file map that satisfies all FUSA001-005 built-in rules; testutil.GoSource shall return MinimalProject extended with the given Go source file.

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity threshold by DAL
requirements.text: comp.ThresholdForDAL shall return the cyclomatic complexity threshold for a given DO-178C DAL: DAL-A=4, DAL-B=10, DAL-C=15, DAL-D=20; unknown DAL returns the default threshold (10).

requirements.title: Cyclomatic complexity assessment
requirements.text: comp.Assess shall walk all non-test Go source files under projectRoot (excluding vendor, testdata, and hidden directories), compute cyclomatic complexity for each function with a body, and return a FunctionResult per function indicating whether it exceeds the given threshold.

requirements.title: gofusa comp command
requirements.text: gofusa comp shall run comp.Assess against --dir, render results in --format (text|json), and exit with ExitOK (no exceedances), ExitGateFail (one or more exceedances), or ExitUsage (bad flag/format). The --dal flag selects a DO-178C DAL threshold; --threshold overrides it when both are provided.

requirements.title: Markdown compliance report
requirements.text: report.Render with format "md" or "markdown" shall produce a GitHub/Confluence-compatible Markdown report with a heading, summary table (ERROR/WARNING/INFO/Total counts), and a findings table (Rule|Severity|File|Line|Message). Pipe characters in message text shall be escaped.

requirements.title: SIL and DAL fields in compliance report
requirements.text: report.Report shall carry distinct sil (IEC 61508) and dal (DO-178C) fields alongside the existing asil (ISO 26262) field. Callers populate the appropriate field based on the active standard; all three are omitempty in JSON output.

requirements.title: Markdown traceability matrix
requirements.text: trace.Render with format "md" or "markdown" shall produce a Markdown Requirements Traceability Matrix with a coverage summary table and per-requirement status (traced+tested / traced / untraced).

requirements.title: location.file is project-relative
requirements.text: All Finding.Location.File values produced by lint and analyze rules shall be paths relative to projectRoot using forward-slash separators. Absolute paths are prohibited. This ensures fingerprints (§4.2) are portable across environments.

requirements.title: capabilities Standards array uses canonical IDs
requirements.text: The capabilities.Standards array shall contain only canonical §2.4.1 lower-case IDs (e.g. "slsa", not "slsa-v1.0"). Version suffixes are not part of the canonical enum.

requirements.title: HLR/LLR hierarchical traceability
requirements.text: The tool shall detect HLR/LLR decomposition violations: LLRs whose parentId is absent or references a non-existent HLR (orphaned), and HLRs that have no LLR children (uncovered). The engine rule TRACE008 shall emit WARNING severity by default and ERROR when project ASIL is ASIL-D. The CLI --strict-hlr-llr flag shall gate on any violation regardless of ASIL.

requirements.title: Tool qualification method and record display
requirements.text: The qualify command shall accept --qualification-method (self|independent), --qualifier (identity string), and --record-uri (URI to dossier) flags and store them in the qualification report. The report shall expose a QualificationBadge() method returning independently-qualified, self-qualified, or unqualified.

requirements.title: V&V independence declaration in qualification
requirements.text: The qualify command shall accept --implementation-author, --independent-reviewer, --independent-test-executor, and --achievable-asil flags and store them in the qualification report. The IndependenceStatus() method shall return independent when reviewer differs from author, self-reviewed when they are the same, or unqualified when no reviewer is set.

requirements.title: DO-178C structural coverage report
requirements.text: The tool shall produce a DO-178C structural coverage report including statement coverage percentage, decision coverage approximation, and MC/DC requirement flag for the given DAL.

requirements.title: Parse Go coverage profile
requirements.text: The tool shall parse Go coverage profiles in the standard go test -coverprofile format into a slice of coverage blocks.

requirements.title: Render coverage report in text and JSON
requirements.text: The tool shall render the coverage report in both text and JSON formats.

requirements.title: MC/DC coverage measurement and gate
requirements.text: The coverage command shall accept --mcdc, --mcdc-file (path to LLVM coverage JSON), and --mcdc-threshold (0-100) flags. A condition is MC/DC covered when covered_true_count > 0 AND covered_false_count > 0. The gate shall fail when overall condition coverage falls below the threshold.

requirements.title: Function-level tag coverage (x-FuSa spec §1.4.1 item 2)
requirements.text: trace.ScanFuncTagCoverage shall count exported top-level functions/methods in non-test .go files that carry a //fusa:req tag directly above them in their doc comment, excluding trivial fmt.Stringer/error-interface shims and boilerplate zero-parameter getters, and report the percentage covered.

requirements.title: --func-coverage CLI gate
requirements.text: gofusa trace --func-coverage N shall exit 1 when fewer than N%% of exported functions/methods carry a //fusa:req tag directly above them; N=0 disables the gate (x-FuSa spec §5).

requirements.title: Dangling //fusa:test tag detection
requirements.text: The trace engine shall report a WARNING finding (TRACE009, category requirement) for every //fusa:test tag whose requirement ID does not exist in .fusa-reqs.json, the same way a malformed annotation is treated (x-FuSa spec §1.4.1 item 3).

requirements.title: Watchdog Start begins periodic liveness monitoring
requirements.text: runtime.Watchdog.Start shall begin the periodic expiry-check goroutine and return an error if the watchdog is already running.

requirements.title: Watchdog Stop halts monitoring safely
requirements.text: runtime.Watchdog.Stop shall halt the monitoring goroutine and be safe to call when the watchdog is not running (idempotent no-op).

requirements.title: Watchdog Kick resets the liveness timer
requirements.text: runtime.Watchdog.Kick shall reset the last-kick timestamp, preventing onExpiry from firing while kicks continue within the timeout window.

requirements.title: Watchdog IsRunning reports monitoring state
requirements.text: runtime.Watchdog.IsRunning shall report false before Start and after Stop, and true while monitoring is active.

requirements.title: Heartbeat Start begins periodic beat monitoring
requirements.text: runtime.Heartbeat.Start shall begin the periodic missed-beat check goroutine and return an error if the heartbeat is already running.

requirements.title: Heartbeat Stop halts monitoring safely
requirements.text: runtime.Heartbeat.Stop shall halt the monitoring goroutine and be safe to call when the heartbeat is not running (idempotent no-op).

requirements.title: Heartbeat Beat signals liveness
requirements.text: runtime.Heartbeat.Beat shall record the current time as the last beat and reset the consecutive-missed-beat counter to zero.

requirements.title: Heartbeat IsRunning reports monitoring state
requirements.text: runtime.Heartbeat.IsRunning shall report false before Start and after Stop, and true while monitoring is active.

requirements.title: FaultMonitor SetThreshold configures per-fault callback threshold
requirements.text: runtime.FaultMonitor.SetThreshold shall set the count at which onFault fires for the given faultID; a threshold of 0 shall disable callback firing for that fault.

requirements.title: FaultMonitor Record increments count and fires at threshold
requirements.text: runtime.FaultMonitor.Record shall increment the counter for faultID and invoke onFault(faultID, count) once the counter reaches or exceeds the configured threshold.

requirements.title: Parse DOORS ReqIF XML
requirements.text: trace.ParseDOORS shall parse a DOORS ReqIF XML document and return the requirements it contains as Requirement records.

requirements.title: Export DOORS ReqIF XML
requirements.text: trace.ExportDOORS shall serialise a slice of Requirement records as minimal DOORS ReqIF XML that round-trips through ParseDOORS.

requirements.title: Parse Codebeamer tracker XML
requirements.text: trace.ParseCodebeamer shall parse a Codebeamer tracker XML export and return the requirements it contains as Requirement records, including ASIL/level custom fields.

requirements.title: Export Codebeamer tracker XML
requirements.text: trace.ExportCodebeamer shall serialise a slice of Requirement records as Codebeamer tracker XML that round-trips through ParseCodebeamer.

requirements.title: Parse Jama Connect XML
requirements.text: trace.ParseJama shall parse a Jama Connect XML export and return the requirements it contains as Requirement records, including ASIL/level custom fields.

requirements.title: Export Jama Connect XML
requirements.text: trace.ExportJama shall serialise a slice of Requirement records as Jama Connect XML that round-trips through ParseJama.

requirements.title: Parse Polarion workitems XML
requirements.text: trace.ParsePolarion shall parse a Polarion workitems XML export and return the requirements it contains as Requirement records, including the ASIL custom field.

requirements.title: Export Polarion workitems XML
requirements.text: trace.ExportPolarion shall serialise a slice of Requirement records as Polarion workitems XML that round-trips through ParsePolarion.

requirements.title: Mutation testing execution produces DAL-tagged report
requirements.text: coverage.RunMutation shall invoke go-mutesting against projectRoot and return a MutationReport tagged with the given DAL; when go-mutesting is not found in PATH it shall return a report with an explanatory Note and MCDCEvidence set, and a nil error.

requirements.title: Registry.Register rejects nil and duplicate rule IDs
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Register shall return an error when passed a nil Rule or when a rule with the same ID has already been registered, and otherwise add the rule to the registry.

requirements.title: Registry.Rules returns rules sorted by ID
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Rules shall return a copy of the registered rules ordered by ascending rule ID, giving callers a deterministic iteration order.

requirements.title: Result.HasWarnings reports WARNING or ERROR findings
requirements.text: engine.Result.HasWarnings shall return true if any Finding in the result carries SeverityWarning or SeverityError, supporting gofusa check --strict.

requirements.title: Registry.Run executes all non-excluded rules
requirements.text: engine.Registry.Run shall execute all registered rules against projectRoot except those listed in cfg.Rules.Exclude, equivalent to calling RunFilter with a nil keep predicate.

requirements.title: DeriveCategory maps rule ID prefixes to categories
requirements.text: fusa.DeriveCategory shall map a rule ID's alphabetic prefix to its Category per the §1.5.1 prefix registry (case-insensitive), returning CategoryOther for unrecognised or empty prefixes.

requirements.title: ComputeFingerprint derives a stable SHA-256 finding fingerprint
requirements.text: fusa.ComputeFingerprint shall compute the §4.2 canonical SHA-256 fingerprint from a Finding's RuleID, project-relative Location.File, and digit/whitespace-normalised Message, producing a stable value across repeated calls and differing values when RuleID, File, or normalised Message differ.

requirements.title: Report.HasFailures reports any failed qualification case
requirements.text: qualify.Report.HasFailures shall return true when the report's Failed count is greater than zero, and false otherwise.

requirements.title: DiagManager.Record appends and evicts oldest on overflow
requirements.text: runtime.DiagManager.Record shall append a Diagnostic entry with the given id, level, and message, evicting the oldest buffered entry when the manager is at capacity.

requirements.title: DiagManager.Diagnostics returns a snapshot copy
requirements.text: runtime.DiagManager.Diagnostics shall return a copy of all buffered Diagnostic entries in oldest-first order, safe for the caller to retain without affecting the manager's internal state.

requirements.title: DiagManager.Clear removes all buffered diagnostics
requirements.text: runtime.DiagManager.Clear shall remove all buffered Diagnostic entries, resetting Count to zero.

requirements.title: DiagManager.Count reports buffered entry count
requirements.text: runtime.DiagManager.Count shall return the number of Diagnostic entries currently buffered.

requirements.title: FaultMonitor.Reset zeroes a fault's counter
requirements.text: runtime.FaultMonitor.Reset shall set the counter for the given faultID back to zero without invoking the onFault callback.

requirements.title: FaultMonitor.Count reports a fault's current counter
requirements.text: runtime.FaultMonitor.Count shall return the current counter value for the given faultID, returning zero for a faultID that has never been recorded.

requirements.title: StateManager.State returns the current safe state
requirements.text: runtime.StateManager.State shall return the manager's current State, starting at StateOperational until a successful Transition changes it.

requirements.title: StateManager.Transition moves state and notifies onChange
requirements.text: runtime.StateManager.Transition shall move the manager to the target State and invoke the onChange callback with (from, to) on success; a transition to the current state shall be a no-op that does not invoke onChange.

requirements.title: ScanTags walks a source tree collecting annotation tags
requirements.text: trace.ScanTags shall walk all .go files under root (skipping vendor, testdata, and dot-prefixed directories), returning every //fusa:req, //fusa:test, and //fusa:sec-test annotation found as a Tag with its file, line, kind, and requirement ID.

requirements.title: ResolveDoc falls back to the docs/safety/ scaffold path
requirements.text: fusa.ResolveDoc shall return the project-root-relative path to a scaffolded safety document if present, else the docs/safety/<name> path gofusa template/init write by default if that file is one of the known scaffold filenames and exists there instead, else an empty string, so Assess/Build evidence checks do not report false gaps for freshly-scaffolded projects.

requirements.title: Dropped context detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report an INFO finding (ANA005) when a function that already receives a context.Context parameter calls context.Background() or context.TODO() internally instead of propagating the received context.

requirements.title: Unwrapped error detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (ANA006) for fmt.Errorf calls that do not use the %w verb, since the resulting error loses its chain and callers cannot use errors.Is/As to inspect the underlying error.

requirements.title: Unchecked two-result nil-dereference risk
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (ANA007) when the non-error value from a two-result function call (val, err := f()) is used on the very next line without an intervening error check, indicating a nil-dereference risk.

requirements.title: Goroutine shared-variable access
requirements.text: The tool shall report a WARNING finding (ANA008) when a goroutine function literal accesses a package-level variable without going through a synchronisation primitive, indicating a potential data race.

requirements.title: Dead code detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (ANA009) for any statement that is unreachable because it follows an unconditional return, break, continue, or panic within the same block, per DO-178C §6.4.4.2's prohibition on dead code at DAL-A/B.

requirements.title: New returns a Badge derived from finding counts
requirements.text: New returns a Badge derived from finding counts.

requirements.title: Render writes the badge as a self-contained SVG to w
requirements.text: Render writes the badge as a self-contained SVG to w.

requirements.title: Generate an SVG status badge
requirements.text: Generate an SVG status badge. Reads a gofusa check --format json report, or reads from stdin if no file is given.

requirements.title: Report the tool's supported commands, formats, and standards
requirements.text: Report the tool's supported commands, formats, and standards.

requirements.title: Run safety checks
requirements.text: Run safety checks. Exits 1 if any ERROR-severity findings exist.

requirements.title: Analyse data and control coupling between packages (DO-178C §6.4.4.3)
requirements.text: Analyse data and control coupling between packages (DO-178C §6.4.4.3). Writes coupling-report.json as evidence of coupling characterisation.

requirements.title: Produce a DO-178C structural coverage report from a Go coverage profile
requirements.text: Produce a DO-178C structural coverage report from a Go coverage profile. Generate coverage.out with: go test -coverprofile=coverage.out ./...

requirements.title: Compare two gofusa check --format json report files
requirements.text: Compare two gofusa check --format json report files. Exits 1 if any new findings were introduced.

requirements.title: Manage finding disposition entries
requirements.text: Manage finding disposition entries. Subcommands: add Add a new disposition entry list List all disposition entries show Show the disposition entry for a specific rule Global flags: gofusa disposition: get working directory: %v

requirements.title: Generate a DO-178C compliance gap report
requirements.text: Generate a DO-178C compliance gap report. Maps evidence to Annex A objectives and reports PASS/GAP/MANUAL/N/A.

requirements.title: Show auto-fixable findings from gofusa check
requirements.text: Show auto-fixable findings from gofusa check. Prints a remediation summary; use --report to also save the report.

requirements.title: Manage the Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (.fusa-hara.json)
requirements.text: Manage the Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (.fusa-hara.json). Subcommands: show Display HARA as text or JSON (default) init Create a starter .fusa-hara.json asil Derive ASIL from S/E/C parameters Flags: gofusa hara: get working directory: %v

requirements.title: parseFlags parses a command's flag set and returns fusa.ExitUsage on error
requirements.text: parseFlags parses a command's flag set and returns fusa.ExitUsage on error. Use in place of the inline `if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil { return 1 }` pattern.

requirements.title: usageErrorf prints a usage-error message to stderr and returns ExitUsage (2)
requirements.text: usageErrorf prints a usage-error message to stderr and returns ExitUsage (2).

requirements.title: runtimeErrorf prints a runtime-error message to stderr and returns ExitRuntime (3)
requirements.text: runtimeErrorf prints a runtime-error message to stderr and returns ExitRuntime (3).

requirements.title: Manage git hooks for go-FuSa integration
requirements.text: Manage git hooks for go-FuSa integration. Subcommands: install Install pre-commit hook into .git/hooks/ remove Remove the go-FuSa pre-commit hook show Print the hook script to stdout

requirements.title: Generate an IEC 61508 Parts 1-3 compliance gap report
requirements.text: Generate an IEC 61508 Parts 1-3 compliance gap report.

requirements.title: Analyse the impact of source changes on requirements and safety artefacts
requirements.text: Analyse the impact of source changes on requirements and safety artefacts.

requirements.title: Initialise a go-FuSa configuration in the project root
requirements.text: Initialise a go-FuSa configuration in the project root.

requirements.title: Generate an ISO 21434 cybersecurity compliance gap report
requirements.text: Generate an ISO 21434 cybersecurity compliance gap report.

requirements.title: Generate an ISO 26262 Part 6 compliance gap report
requirements.text: Generate an ISO 26262 Part 6 compliance gap report.

requirements.title: Track go-FuSa safety metrics over time
requirements.text: Track go-FuSa safety metrics over time. Subcommands: record Collect and append a metrics snapshot show Display the full metrics time series Global flags: gofusa metrics: get working directory: %v

requirements.title: Show MISRA C:2023 to Go / go-FuSa rule coverage mapping
requirements.text: Show MISRA C:2023 to Go / go-FuSa rule coverage mapping.

requirements.title: Manage software problem reports (DO-178C §11.17)
requirements.text: Manage software problem reports (DO-178C §11.17). Subcommands: init Create an empty .fusa-problems.json add Add a new problem report list List all problem reports close Close a problem report

requirements.title: Generate a safety compliance report
requirements.text: Generate a safety compliance report. Always exits 0.

requirements.title: Show, import, or export requirements
requirements.text: Show, import, or export requirements. Subcommands: (none) Show requirements and their source/test locations import Import requirements from a CSV file export Export requirements to CSV

requirements.title: Import requirements from an external format
requirements.text: gofusa req import --file <path> [--format csv|doors|polarion|codebeamer|jama] shall import requirements from the given external-format file into the project's .fusa-reqs.json, exiting with a usage error if --file is not given.

requirements.title: Export requirements to an external format
requirements.text: gofusa req export [--format csv|doors|polarion|codebeamer|jama] [--output <path>] shall export the project's requirements to the given external format, writing to stdout by default.

requirements.title: Generate a Software Accomplishment Summary (DO-178C §11.20)
requirements.text: Generate a Software Accomplishment Summary (DO-178C §11.20).

requirements.title: Generate the Software Configuration Index (DO-178C §11.16)
requirements.text: Generate the Software Configuration Index (DO-178C §11.16).

requirements.title: Sign or verify a file using HMAC-SHA256
requirements.text: Sign or verify a file using HMAC-SHA256. gofusa sign --key keyfile artifact.zip # creates artifact.zip.sig gofusa sign --verify --key keyfile artifact.zip # verifies artifact.zip.sig gofusa sign --keygen keyfile # generate a new key

requirements.title: --sec-tested CLI gate
requirements.text: gofusa trace --sec-tested N shall exit 1 when fewer than N%% of requirements have //fusa:test tags; N=0 disables the gate.

requirements.title: runTraceSecTested exits 1 if test coverage is below threshold percent
requirements.text: runTraceSecTested exits 1 if test coverage is below threshold percent.

requirements.title: --req-coverage CLI gate
requirements.text: gofusa trace --req-coverage N shall exit 1 when requirement coverage or function annotation density is below N%%; N=0 disables the gate.

requirements.title: Generate a UN R.155 cybersecurity compliance gap report
requirements.text: Generate a UN R.155 cybersecurity compliance gap report.

requirements.title: Run go test and save a test evidence bundle
requirements.text: Run go test and save a test evidence bundle.

requirements.title: Complexity returns the cyclomatic complexity of a function body
requirements.text: Complexity returns the cyclomatic complexity of a function body. V(G) = 1 + number of branching nodes (if, for, range, case, &&, ||, select case).

requirements.title: Exported mutable package-level variable detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (COUP001) for exported, non-const package-level variables, since they represent uncontrolled data coupling between packages per DO-178C §6.4.4.3.

requirements.title: Function/interface-parameter control coupling detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (COUP002) when an exported function accepts a func or interface-typed parameter, since it represents control coupling with the caller per DO-178C §6.4.4.3.

requirements.title: NewDataCouplingRule returns a COUP001 rule instance for testing
requirements.text: NewDataCouplingRule returns a COUP001 rule instance for testing.

requirements.title: NewControlCouplingRule returns a COUP002 rule instance for testing
requirements.text: NewControlCouplingRule returns a COUP002 rule instance for testing.

requirements.title: CouplingReport is the persisted coupling analysis evidence artifact
requirements.text: CouplingReport is the persisted coupling analysis evidence artifact. It satisfies DO-178C §6.4.4.3 (data and control coupling characterisation).

requirements.title: Compare returns the delta between a baseline and a current report

requirements.title: HARA file presence check
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (HARA001) when no .fusa-hara.json file is present in the project, since hazard analysis data is required for ISO 26262 projects.

requirements.title: Incomplete hazard risk rating detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (HARA002) when a Hazard's risk rating is incomplete, i.e. Severity, Exposure, and Controllability are not all set.

requirements.title: Hazard with no linked safety goal detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (HARA003) when a Hazard has no linked SafetyGoal, since every hazard must be mitigated by at least one safety goal.

requirements.title: Safety goal without ASIL detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (HARA004) when a SafetyGoal has no ASIL assigned, since every safety goal must have an ASIL determined from its linked hazard.

requirements.title: Hazard ASIL exceeding project ASIL detection
requirements.text: The tool shall report a finding (HARA005) when the highest hazard ASIL in the HARA exceeds the project ASIL declared in .fusa.json, since that means the project configuration understates risk.

requirements.title: Accept and write both x-FuSa spec and legacy .fusa.json shapes
requirements.text: Config accepts both go-FuSa's legacy .fusa.json shape (top-level "version", "standard"/"asil"/"sil" nested under "project") and the x-FuSa spec §1.2.1 shape (top-level "configVersion", top-level "standard"/"asil"/"sil"/"dal", and the spec's legacy flat "project": "name" string). Load and Save normalise whichever fields are present into both locations, canonicalising the standard id case-insensitively onto go-FuSa's internal enum, so a spec-compliant .fusa.json written by another x-FuSa tool loads without error and go-FuSa's own init output satisfies both shapes at once.

requirements.title: Per-case qualification result status enum (PASS/FAIL/SKIP/ERROR)
requirements.text: Each qualification case result carries a results[].result status string that is one of PASS, FAIL, SKIP, or ERROR, per x-FuSa spec §6. Infrastructure failures (unable to set up or run the synthetic case) report ERROR; a case that runs to completion but doesn't match its expectation reports FAIL; a matching case reports PASS.
